QUOTE: "The index finds 4 spawn sites, all in `programs/`, none in `library/`" and "The library has no thread-spawning code of its own." plus "`mbedtls_mutex_lock` is a function pointer initialised to `threading_mutex_lock_pthread` (`threading.c:103`)" and "Each mutex is a global of type `mbedtls_threading_mutex_t`, initialised by `MUTEX_INIT` in `library/threading.c:182-190`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library/ spawns no threads and that library/threading.c provides the mutex abstraction (the globals and the lock function pointers) used by threaded callers.
